county_overrides.context: Cleveland has Ohio's highest poverty concentration — approximately 30% of residents below poverty line. Cuyahoga County layers additional programs on top of state. Key distinction: Cleveland City and Cuyahoga County are different jurisdictions. Many programs serve county-wide but administer through the City of Cleveland or MetroHealth. Always confirm whether program serves City only vs. full county.
